entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to process a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I received it on December 15th.
Got it. VF886-01, received December 15th. Okay, I see the order. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just a preference, it works fine. I actually tried to return it around December 24th, but I ran into a significant website error. It seemed like the whole return system was down, and I couldn't print the shipping label.
I see. You were trying to initiate the return online but the system wasn't working?
Exactly. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I was worried this might happen. I just got busy with the holidays and am only now getting back to it.
I appreciate you explaining that and for being so prepared with the screenshot. Let me just pull up our current return policy for your item... One moment.

Okay, thanks for waiting. Looking at my knowledge base here, it says all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 28 days ago, you are well within that window. No problem at all.
Oh, 90 days? That's great, much simpler than I thought. I was worried it would be an issue.
Not at all. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Does that work for you?
That's perfect, thank you. Since I did hit that snag with the website, is there any chance of getting a small discount code for a future purchase, just for the trouble?

I understand the request. While I can't offer a discount code as per our policy on preference-based returns, I have just sent that return label to the email on file. You'll receive a full refund for the VeloBand as soon as it's checked in at our warehouse.
Fair enough. Getting the return approved is the main thing. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
